Runtime dependency license inventory

The accompanying dependency-license-review.csv inventories 125 coordinates
resolved from the app runtime dependency graph. All rows were identified as
Apache License 2.0 from cached or official upstream Maven POM metadata, except
com.google.guava:listenablefuture:1.0, whose source file header identifies
Apache License 2.0 while its POM has no license element. The complete Apache
License 2.0 text is included as Apache-2.0.txt.

The coordinate count is not a count of libraries embedded in the APK. It can
include BOMs and multiplatform metadata aliases. This inventory records license
evidence; it does not assert that every coordinate contributes a separate
binary to the package. Directly vendored components have their own notices in
this directory. LibRaw source and license details are in LibRaw-SOURCE.txt.
